preRegistration: path population for stage P of selector B
writtenBefore: any run of the instrument over the corpus and any negative witness arm
isA: restoration of the instrument that produced selector-b.md's sizing table, extended to emit the ordered sha lists, plus a measurement of whether its reproduction check can fail
isNot: a falsification test of any reading of selector-b.md; recovering the original spent that independence

provenance.recovered: the 2026-09-11 counting job ran as a stdin heredoc, wrote no script file, printed all twelve rows and died in its final JSON write (a Git-Bash path handed to a Windows Python)
provenance.recoveredFrom: session transcript of the project directory D--RAGHAD-JAD-Fixor-Final
provenance.consequence: the three constants are copied verbatim; the rule of record is the rule that produced the table

ruleNamedByContent.note: selector-b.md says 'outside the SKIP_PATH_RE segments'. That named one rule when written; #212 widened the secrets-exposure copy and #213 added _test.go to its SKIP_FILE_RE, so the symbol now denotes two rules. Resolve by these strings and digests, never by the symbol.

prosAgainstCodeChecks.check: SKIP against the detector copy at count time

prosAgainstCodeChecks.against: the ten generated-content segments named in selector-b.md
prosAgainstCodeChecks.result: equal; locales? and translations? carry the singular/plural pairs

orderSettledEmpirically.rule: git log emission order, as the recovered job walked it
orderSettledEmpirically.evidence: rebuilding twenty's population under this rule with the packages/twenty-server/src/ prefix reproduces twenty-server-population.shas identically, in order, 5689 of 5689, first identifier 2769f54b959a in both
orderSettledEmpirically.consequence: the FILE is the draw universe, not the command; each list's sha256, parsed record count and repository HEAD are recorded

labelOnTheTwelveRowMatch.isA: a test of corpus stability and of this implementation
labelOnTheTwelveRowMatch.isNot: corroboration that the definition of path population is right
honestLegsClaimed: order-identical reproduction of twenty-server-population.shas, a different artifact built by a different script

negativeWitness.why: the reproduction check had no negative witness, so its discriminating power was assumed rather than measured; every other gate in this measurement earns one (#212 five negative fixtures, #213 fixture 19, the blind reader's planted live key and placeholder)
negativeWitness.departureMeasuredAgainst: this instrument's own unperturbed run of the same repository, never the sizing table
negativeWitness.noRestorationStep: the harness imports and reads the tracked constants and passes its own perturbed copies as parameters; nothing is perturbed in place, so no restore line can be skipped; digests asserted identical before and after

arms.perturbation: SKIP replaced by the widened secrets-exposure copy (scripts?, e2e, e2e-*, api[_-]tests, app-tests)
arms.notSynthetic: this is the rule a future session gets by resolving the symbol against secrets-exposure.detector.ts

arms.perturbation: a _test\.go$ basename exclusion added, one sub-rule only

arms.blindRegion: caddy's path-population and excluding-generated columns are equal in the sizing table, so GEN removes nothing there and no perturbation of it can depart; four of twelve repositories are in this state (caddy, full-stack-fastapi-template, hoppscotch, langchain)

arms.perturbation: semantics changed to drop-if-any-generated, a perturbation of the READING rather than of a regex character

negativeWitness.boundCheckedOnEveryArm: the excluding-generated count can never exceed the path-population count
negativeWitness.consequenceIfAnyPredictedDepartureFails: STOP: reported, not repaired in the same execution, and the twelve-repository run does not follow; the harness exits non-zero
negativeWitness.r12: each result is earned only for the repository it ran on

run.population: the as-recovered arm, because it is the instrument that produced the committed sizing table
run.control: no_renames; a per-repository divergence is a recorded property of the universe, not a defect to repair
run.headRule: captured before and after each repository's walk; a difference aborts that repository and no other; a later HEAD change re-opens that repository's draw and nothing else
run.atomicity: each repository's two lists and its JSON are written the moment that repository completes, through a temporary name, so a halt at a repository boundary loses nothing and leaves no partial list
run.recordCounts: parsed, never wc -l; lists written with a trailing newline, after the 5688-against-5689 discrepancy already in a landed artifact
run.drawUniverse: the excluding-generated list; the sizing table's twelve rows sum to 157996

sizingTableBaselines.note: recorded here for reference only; the witness compares against the instrument's own unperturbed run, not against these
